clues.text: Gideon told God he would set it out overnight on a threshing floor.
Gideon asked that dew settle only on this, while all the ground around it stayed dry.
Rising early the next morning, Gideon squeezed it and wrung out a full bowl of dew.
Gideon begged God not to be angry with him before asking for one more test with it.
On the second night, God kept this dry while dew covered all the ground around it.
After rallying tribes against Midian, Gideon used it to learn if God would save Israel by his hand.
Job said the needy blessed him because he warmed them with this, taken from his sheep.
